verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical and both are broken. On the left, 'When Life Is Rough' sits above 'PRAY', but on the right 'When Life Is Great' and 'PRAY' sit side by side, so the parallel couplet loses its symmetry. The text is small with a lot of empty space, and the rose is clipped to a hard rectangle at its left edge. A is slightly worse because its second 'PRAY' is clearly larger than the first, which makes the type sizes inconsistent and the right side top-heavy. B keeps the two 'PRAY's closer in size and gives the top line a bit more presence.
